name: XAgent
description: Experimental autonomous agent that plans and solves general tasks, running all its actions inside a Docker tool server.
whatItDoes: Takes a task and works on it without supervision, optionally asking the human for help or following guidance mid-run. Records every step so a run can be replayed. Offers both a command line and a web GUI.
howItWorks: A dispatcher hands work to planner and actor agents, and actions execute in a containerised ToolServer. It is started with a task and a YAML config holding OpenAI keys, or through a web UI served on port 5173.

requirements.name: OpenAI API key
requirements.description: Set in assets/config.yml; GPT-4 class models recommended
